beat.name: New Mexico v. the Justice Department

state.v: San Rafael Ranch LLC (Huffines family), since 2023
Construction paused for want of permits

history.c: Federal suit → filed against DOJ and Blanche in D.D.C.
Truth commission → began, with subpoena power.
Site searched by NMDOJ with State Police and K-9 units; excavation and altered substrate reported.
State criminal probe → reopened following the January federal release.
Beneficial owner revealed as the Huffines family after a street-name change and a tax contest.
Site ownership → San Rafael Ranch LLC at public auction; beneficial owner concealed.
history.s: Santa Fe New Mexican; The Real Deal

history.c: Federal prosecution ended with the defendant's death. Stated rationale for the stand-down ceased to apply.
Stand-down requested → state investigation paused on a federal promise.
